optimizedContext.value:
# Resolve Symbol Reference

## Rules
- `ResolveSymbolReference` accepts workspace, text, optional file/public surface/symbol space/broad kind/member semantics/owner/build context. Structured fields and escaped round-tripping canonical references are authoritative; no ad hoc delimiter splitting.
- `Tipo.miembro` or `Tipo::miembro` compares equality on stored dotted `qualified_name`; no file/language required, no adapter sweep/default. Return every match; optional file/surface filters visibility; none→unresolved.
- Other human owner-qualified text selects adapter from explicit language, anchored file language, then public-surface metadata; none→unresolved. Language controls identifier case/normalization; path/workspace normalization stays separate. No `MemberForm` input.
- Canonical target is one logical symbol retaining every contributing declaration. Same logical overload/merge resolves; genuinely competing logical symbols are ambiguous. Target exposes workspace, module/package, owner, symbol space, simple name, member form, locations, stable location-independent canonical reference.
- Public slot = surface+exported name+space; each target/provenance route remains independently addressable. Local bindings retain scope/range; shadowing stays separate. Default/anonymous exports remain binding-addressable.
- Precedence: (1) exact canonical logical ID; (2) exact `qualified_name`; (3) exact declaration in addressed file/owner; (4) exact public binding on addressed surface; (5) proven scoped import/alias; (6) proven hierarchy path.
- Owner resolves before member. Never terminal-name/rank inference. File path alone cannot select public binding. Build context may select alternatives; cycles terminate without duplicate candidates.
- Outcomes exactly `resolved`, `ambiguous`, `unresolved`, `missing`. Non-resolved includes stable reason, ordered candidates, typed ordered evidence. `missing` only with current complete addressed evidence.
- Batch `AssessIndexedResourceFreshness` evaluates addressed resources and every contributing declaration file; deduplicate inputs. Resolver embeds no filesystem/repository/hash/persistence logic.
- Exact fresh file-anchored resolution may proceed despite unrelated global staleness. Workspace-wide fallback, uniqueness, ambiguity, or absence needing corpus completeness becomes unresolved when global state stale/unknown.
- Dirty/stale/incompatible/excluded/unsupported/parse-failed/partial evidence→unresolved, never missing. Assessment failure→`freshness-unknown`. Fresh complete addressed file/surface may prove missing. Provider/generation failures remain infrastructure errors.
- Declared/overriding member beats inherited; contract-qualified selects contract member. Language precedence governs inherited/trait/mixin/embedded/promoted/abstract/default members.
- Ancestor traversal queries requested member under reached owner; owner alone is not member evidence. Preserve owner path and ancestor-member declaration. Competing inheritance→ambiguous; same-name accessor forms require semantics when language cannot select; implicit interfaces require proven method sets; cycles terminate.
- Batch resolution shares one health snapshot/provider lifecycle, indexed bounded traversal, no full-graph scan per query. Ordering/status/reasons identical across backends.

## Constraints
- No stored-link or sidecar mutation.
- No fuzzy matching, edit distance, rank-based guess, runtime reflection, computed imports, monkey patching, unproven value flow.
- Adapter syntax analysis stays in language adapters.
